objective: Strengthen the existing Cloud IaC local foundation with code-backed OpenTofu module catalog coherence invariants while keeping live registry, module signing, provider locks, filesystem scanning, and tofu runtime execution as explicit non-claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: OpenTofu module identity is namespace/name/system plus semver versions; the domain guard rejects duplicate namespace/name/system/version entries.
Reusable shared modules should use registry/source discipline with versioning; this slice keeps the local skeleton catalog truthful until a live registry exists.
Provider lock files and checksum review are a separate runtime/provider proof; this ChangeSet records provider locks as a non-claim.

implemented_claims: LocalOpenTofuModuleCatalog validates a local catalog id, repo-relative source root, non-empty entries, duplicate module identity rejection, and root containment for entry source paths.
LocalOpenTofuModuleCatalogEntry validates namespace/name/system/version metadata, repo-relative source/main paths, evidence refs, and exactly <source_path>/main.tofu.
LocalModuleReleaseStatus::LocalFoundationSkeleton fails closed when provider_resources_implemented, outputs_materialized, or tests_present are true.
Cloud IaC manifest advertises the new catalog coherence invariant only as a local domain guard and preserves runtime/provider/module-signing non-claims.
explicit_non_claims: No live OpenTofu private module registry API exists.
No module signing/cosign attestation, provider mirror, or provider dependency lock evidence is implemented by this ChangeSet.
No tofu init, validate, test, plan, apply, drift detection, REST, SDK, worker, provider adapter, or Argo CD API integration is implemented by this ChangeSet.
The Rust domain guard does not read the filesystem or parse the JSON catalog; actual file/catalog coherence was verified by an evidence-time custom check only.
false_green_findings_closed: A local-foundation-skeleton catalog entry can no longer claim provider resources, outputs, or tests through the domain type.
Catalog entries can no longer point outside the declared source root or use a non-main.tofu entrypoint through the domain type.
Duplicate namespace/name/system/version catalog entries are rejected before future registry/runtime adapters build on them.
known_gaps: This slice intentionally does not implement filesystem scanning in a first-class Oya gate; it adds pure domain invariants and records a custom evidence-time coherence check.
Legacy Cloud IaC Markdown/IP/capability prose still contains future-state planning language and remains de-authorized by manifest non-claims.
Live registry/runtime/provider/OpenTofu/Argo CD work remains sequentially blocked behind future contract slices.

findings: The implementation adds small value objects and invariants rather than a broad parser/runtime stack.
No new dependency was introduced; JSON/filesystem parsing stays out of the pure domain crate.
Catalog identity follows OpenTofu namespace/name/system/version shape and rejects duplicate versions.
Provider lock, module-signature, and runtime execution proof remain explicit non-claims to avoid false hyperscaler readiness.

alternatives_named: Implement a live module registry API now
Add serde_json parsing to the domain crate
Add pure domain catalog invariants now and leave parsing/runtime adapters for later
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Pure domain invariants are the smallest truthful step: they prevent catalog overclaim patterns without crossing dependency seams or claiming runtime readiness.
rejected_reasons: A live registry API is too broad for this slice and would require contracts, adapters, auth, persistence, and provider/runtime evidence.
Adding serde_json to the domain crate would violate the repository's dependency-seam posture for pure domain types.

findings: No secrets or tenant data were added; existing evidence-ref secret-like rejection remains in place.
The catalog guard reduces configuration overclaim risk by rejecting outside-root paths and skeleton readiness flags.
Catalog validation is O(n log n) over entry count via BTreeMap duplicate detection; current catalog has six entries.
No runtime observability is claimed; evidence records the exact verification commands and custom coherence log path.
Existing public domain types remain available; new catalog types are additive.
Manifest capabilities remain T1 local metadata claims only.
tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md document scope, acceptance criteria, verification, and non-claims.
